title: Hosea's Wife and Children

questions.question: Who was the father of Hosea?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:1 (ESV): "The word of the Lord that came to Hosea, the son of Beeri..."

questions.question: What did the Lord command Hosea to do in the beginning?
options: Take a wife of whoredom and have children of whoredom
questions.correctAnswer: Take a wife of whoredom and have children of whoredom
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:2 (ESV): "Go, take to yourself a wife of whoredom and have children of whoredom,"

questions.question: What was the name of Hosea's wife?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:3 (ESV): "So he went and took Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim,"

questions.question: What was the name of the first son born to Gomer?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:4 (ESV): "And the Lord said to him, 'Call his name Jezreel...'"

questions.question: What did the name Lo-ruhamah mean?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:6 (ESV): "Call her name Lo-ruhamah, for I will no more have mercy on the house of Israel,"

questions.question: Why did God say to name the third child Lo-ammi?
options: For you are not my people, and I am not your God
questions.correctAnswer: For you are not my people, and I am not your God
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:9 (ESV): "Call his name Lo-ammi, for you are not my people, and I am not your God."

questions.question: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be like the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:10 (ESV): "Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be like the sand of the sea,"

questions.question: In the place where it was said to them, "You are not my people," it shall be said to them, "Children of the..."?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:10 (ESV): "it shall be said to them, 'Children of the living God.'"

questions.question: The children of Judah and the children of Israel shall be gathered together and appoint for themselves how many heads?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:11 (ESV): "And the children of Judah and the children of Israel shall be gathered together, and they shall appoint for themselves one head."

questions.question: During the reigns of which kings of Judah did the word of the Lord come to Hosea?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:1 (ESV): "in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah,"

questions.question: Why did the Lord command Hosea to take a wife of whoredom?
options: For the land commits great whoredom by forsaking the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: For the land commits great whoredom by forsaking the Lord
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:2 (ESV): "for the land commits great whoredom by forsaking the Lord."

questions.question: God said He would break the bow of Israel in the Valley of whom?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:5 (ESV): "And on that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel."

questions.question: Upon whom did God say He would have mercy?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:7 (ESV): "But I will have mercy on the house of Judah,"

questions.question: By what means did God say He would NOT save Judah?
options: Bow or by sword or by war or by horses or by horsemen
questions.correctAnswer: Bow or by sword or by war or by horses or by horsemen
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:7 (ESV): "and I will save them by the Lord their God. I will not save them by bow or by sword or by war or by horses or by horsemen."

questions.question: Who was the king of Israel mentioned in the first verse?
questions.explanation: Hosea 1:1 (ESV): "and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel."

key_verse_text: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or numbered. And in the place where it was said to them, "You are not my people," it shall be said to them, "Children of the living God."
